name: code_sandbox_light_284862f4_1775050501
description: A beautiful, mobile-first web application built for long-distance couples. Krisha keeps partners emotionally close through real-time mood syncing, secret sharing, quick love interactions, and emergency features — all wrapped in a romantic dark UI.

scripts.copy:web: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Copy-Item -Path index.html -Destination web/index.html -Force; if (Test-Path logo.png) { Copy-Item -Path logo.png -Destination web/logo.png -Force }"
scripts.fix:java17: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$f1='android/app/capacitor.build.gradle'; if (Test-Path $f1) { (Get-Content $f1 -Raw).Replace('JavaVersion.VERSION_21','JavaVersion.VERSION_17') | Set-Content $f1 }; $f2='node_modules/@capacitor/local-notifications/android/build.gradle'; if (Test-Path $f2) { (Get-Content $f2 -Raw).Replace('JavaVersion.VERSION_21','JavaVersion.VERSION_17') | Set-Content $f2 }"
scripts.android:sync: npm run copy:web && npx cap sync android && npm run fix:java17
scripts.cap:sync: npm run copy:web && npx cap sync android && npm run fix:java17
scripts.cap:sync:ios: npm run copy:web && npx cap sync ios
scripts.cap:sync:all: npm run copy:web && npx cap sync && npm run fix:java17
scripts.apk:debug: npm run cap:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
